differences.title: 1. DATA MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Models data as nodes and relationships with properties, offering flexible schema and intuitive querying via Cypher.
differences.rightDesc: Also uses nodes, relationships, and properties, enabling expressive graph traversals and pattern matching with Cypher.

differences.title: 2. QUERY LANGUAGE
differences.leftDesc: Declarative, ASCII-art-like query language for pattern matching and graph traversal, optimized for readability and expressiveness.
differences.rightDesc: Implements Cypher, allowing seamless migration and leveraging its powerful pattern matching capabilities for graph analysis.

differences.title: 3. STORAGE ENGINE
differences.leftDesc: Stores data on disk, utilizing memory caching for performance. Optimized for durability and large datasets.
differences.rightDesc: Keeps the entire graph in RAM for extreme read/write speeds, ideal for real-time analytics and low latency.

differences.title: 4. PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Offers reliable performance for complex traversals, balancing disk I/O with efficient indexing strategies for most workloads.
differences.rightDesc: Achieves very high throughput and low latency due to its in-memory architecture, excelling in high-velocity graph operations.

differences.title: 5. EXTENSIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: Leverages APOC for utility procedures and Graph Data Science (GDS) library for advanced algorithms and machine learning.
differences.rightDesc: Offers MAGE (Memgraph Advanced Graph Extensions) for custom algorithms and data ingestion, extensible with Python/C++.

differences.title: 6. TRANSACTION MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Ensures data integrity with ACID transactions, providing robust consistency for critical applications and data modifications.
differences.rightDesc: Supports ACID transactions, guaranteeing consistency and reliability for concurrent operations on its in-memory dataset.

differences.title: 7. USE CASES
differences.leftDesc: Ideal for fraud detection, recommendation engines, identity and access management, and network infrastructure analysis.
differences.rightDesc: Suited for real-time fraud detection, IoT sensor analysis, streaming graph processing, and low-latency graph insights.
